recipes.name: Boiled chestnuts (Bam: 밤)
instructions: Wash the chestnuts thoroughly by rubbing them with both hands, changing the water several times. Drain the chestnuts.

Place the washed chestnuts in a heavy pan or pot. Add enough water to cover the chestnuts, about 1 inch from the surface. Cover the pan and cook over medium-high heat for 30 minutes. Open the lid and stir the chestnuts with a wooden spoon. Reduce the heat to medium and continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pan from heat. Drain the boiled chestnuts and rinse them under cold running water. Allow the chestnuts to drain thoroughly.
Place a cooked chestnut on the cutting board. Use a kitchen knife to carefully cut into the tip of the chestnut. Cut the chestnut in half. Scoop out the tender chestnut flesh with a small spoon.
